# Orbit Player

> Orbit Player is a connected poker-room player network developed by Caminus Labs, LLC. Its public landing page explains the service; verified accounts can browse nearby room-published games and manage club memberships, waitlists, and tournament registrations.

Intended public site: https://orbitpoker.com/
Developer: https://caminuslabs.com/
Source: https://github.com/sahusgupta/orbit

## Public pages

- `/`: Product information, presentation-only examples, and factual product questions.
- `/sign-in`: Account creation, email verification, sign-in, and password reset.
- `/privacy`: Orbit's user-facing privacy disclosure.

## Verified-account pages

- `/games` and `/games/{entity}`: Search, filter, and inspect room-published games.
- `/tournaments` and `/tournaments/{entity}`: Search, filter, and inspect scheduled tournaments.
- `/clubs` and `/clubs/{entity}`: Search participating poker rooms and inspect their current inventory.
- `/me`: Authenticated player account overview.
- `/me/games`: Authenticated waitlist and game-request state.
- `/me/tournaments`: Authenticated tournament-registration state.
- `/me/clubs`: Authenticated club-membership state.
- `/me/profile`: Authenticated player profile.

All product and account routes other than the landing page require verified authentication and are excluded from search and AI crawler indexing. Joining a game, registering for a tournament, and requesting club membership are sent to the Orbit API with an independently verified Firebase token. The landing page contains presentation-only examples and does not expose protected discovery data.

## Data interpretation

Room-published state is current operational information, not a guarantee of availability. The site uses explicit empty, unavailable, and reconnecting states when an API projection cannot be loaded. Orbit does not publish fabricated reviews, visitor counters, endorsements, or performance metrics.
